summary: A four-year-old's birthday at Coyote Point with nothing to investigate. Dakota called Ortiz on the drive and brought Yui her rights to her own file, with a bouquet and an apology he could not explain. Mars headbutted Dakota on the way back to the car, lost an argument about Santa to a toddler, was filmed by outraged parents, and became 'Mezzanine' to every child on the lawn. Dakota discovered that 'Simon says' is a superpower and used it on Mars. Morgan fixed a cake a room of adults had decided was fine and got a high four. Mira read a photograph somebody had cut with scissors, got a headache, and let it be. Mei choked on a grape and Priya had it out before anyone else noticed, then could not eat, and sat with Yui. Nia finally named the day: Saturday the 27th.
